    Proposition 6.5(1) for arbitrary filtered lifts #

    prop:positive-module-lifting(1): "Each M_i has a filtered lift M_i^B with gr M_i^B = M_i, unique up to an isomorphism with prescribed leading identity."

    FLift is a B-action on the graded space M itself. Here a filtered lift is any right B-module N with a finite decreasing filtration F^p N, compatible with the filtration of B, and an identification gr N = M of graded Λ-modules: symbols ι_p : F^p N → M_p, onto, with kernel F^{p+1} N, and ι_{p+d}(n x) = ι_p(n) σ_d(x) (GenLift). As in the source, choosing linear sections of the ι_p identifies N with M as filtered spaces and carries the action to an FLift (GenLift.exists_model). Hence a lift exists (exists_genLift) and two filtered lifts are isomorphic by a B-linear isomorphism preserving the filtrations with leading term the identity (genLift_unique).

    Type (max (max u_1 u_2) w)

    A filtered lift of M to B: a right B-module N with a finite decreasing filtration compatible with that of B and an identification gr N = M of graded Λ-modules, given by symbols ι_p : F^p N → M_p, onto, with kernel F^{p+1} N, and multiplicative.

    • act : N →ₗ[k] B →ₗ[k] N
    • mul (n : N) (x y : B) : (self.act ((self.act n) x)) y = (self.act n) (x * y)
    • one (n : N) : (self.act n) 1 = n
    • F : ℤ → Submodule k N
    • anti (p : ℤ) : self.F (p + 1) ≤ self.F p
    • top : ∃ (p₀ : ℤ), self.F p₀ = ⊤
    • bot : ∃ (p₁ : ℤ), self.F p₁ = ⊥
    • act_mem (d : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (n : N) (x : B) : x ∈ P.F d → n ∈ self.F p → (self.act n) x ∈ self.F (p + ↑d)
    • ι : ℤ → N →ₗ[k] M
    • ι_hom (p : ℤ) (n : N) : n ∈ self.F p → MM.gr.IsHom p ((self.ι p) n)
    • ι_ker (p : ℤ) (n : N) : n ∈ self.F p → ((self.ι p) n = 0 ↔ n ∈ self.F (p + 1))
    • ι_surj (p : ℤ) (m : M) : MM.gr.IsHom p m → ∃ n ∈ self.F p, (self.ι p) n = m
    • ι_act (d : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (n : N) (x : B) : x ∈ P.F d → n ∈ self.F p → (self.ι (p + ↑d)) ((self.act n) x) = (MM.act ((self.ι p) n)) ((P.σ d) x)
